activation_cohort_source: The pre-v11 seven-lemma cohort was class-authorized before v11. The Stage 1N four-lemma cohort (aaddi, aammusi, abhi, afceli) was merged as class-only knowledge at commit 0ab8f13d2e5bc932048b413ebb3a82b445193b6a before any v12 answer-source search, remained unactivated through the frozen v12 0/2 baseline, and is activated here uniformly as one cohort.

process_evidence.i_t_assibilation: Green & Morrison (2018) gives kari+t+aa -> karisaa and describes t-assibilation after i; Puglielli & Cabdallah Cumar Mansuur (1997) independently gives kari+t+ay and joogi+t+ay with t -> s after i; Ahmed Mohamed (2013) independently prints kari 2pl karisaan.
process_evidence.i_vowel_glide: Ahmed Mohamed (2013) explicitly prints kariyaa and kariyaan; Green & Jones (2016), table 24, independently prints the same Northern/Benaadir weak-causative present surfaces.
process_evidence.i_n_weak_causative_manner_alternation: Green & Jones (2016), table 24, independently prints Northern/Benaadir weak-causative 1pl karinnaa. Neither the Green 2021 v11 answer table nor either v12 answer source is cited as Stage 1O activation evidence.

benchmark_isolation.note: Stage 1O activates all four Stage 1N class-only lemmas together after v12 was frozen and measured at zero. The activation rule never reads v12 answer rows and does not create target-specific profiles. The two reserve lemmas abhi and afceli are activated by the same mechanics even though no post-activation benchmark answers have been consulted for them.

evidence.class_authorization: Zorc 2019 Somali-English Dictionary class-only registry; all eleven activated lemmas were explicitly labelled v2a before their respective activation experiments.
evidence.present_person_morphology: Existing reviewed MORPH-CONJ-IIA-MPH-001 person/TAM structure and the independent process evidence above, all established before v12 answer-source use.
evidence.stage1o_activation_rationale: Stage 1N selected and merged aaddi, aammusi, abhi and afceli as one class-only cohort before answer lookup. v12 subsequently froze and measured two naturally attested 3pl surfaces at 0/2 while the full four-lemma cohort remained unactivated. Stage 1O now activates the complete preauthorized cohort uniformly using only preexisting C2A processes; v12 answers remain evaluation-only.

notes: Finite class-authorized present generation only. The activation allowlist remains explicit: future reviewed class entries do not auto-activate. Stage 1O adds the complete four-lemma Stage 1N cohort without adding any target-specific profile, new morphophonological process, past generation, reverse stripping, open-class generation, or correction authority. Mechanical outputs for reserve lemmas are not claimed independently attested until separately evaluated.
